item.title: Fatal road rage stabbing incident on I-495; suspect killed
item.description: A Virginia State Police trooper shot and killed a male suspect in self-defense after he was confronted with a knife, following a road rage incident that resulted in four stabbing victims and a dog's death.

item.title: Judge: Manor girls basketball team can continue postseason play
item.description: A Portsmouth judge ruled Monday afternoon that Manor High School's girls basketball team will be allowed to continue play in the state tournament, ruling that a previously ineligible player is, indeed, eligible.

item.title: Naval Station Norfolk updates visitor policy, suspends Trusted Traveler Program
item.description: Naval Station Norfolk has made a significant change to its entry policy, suspending the Trusted Traveler Program and introducing new requirements for visitors.
